answer: Require each agent to lock a stake in a shared orchard fund before it can trade: the stake is planted like a willow cutting and only matures after a history of verified work. A new identity must post collateral, complete paid tasks checked against ground truth, and wait through a seasoning period before its stake bears yield. An attacker creating many fake identities must fund a separate stake for each one, and bad work burns the stake, so fake identities grow costly with every copy while honest agents earn their stake back. Layers of shale-like records make that history hard to forge.
